authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.sourceDependencies: Sufficient runtime foundations through W16; W15 where device telemetry applies
defaults.mission: Production-grade telemetry/evidence, StrategyExecutionRecord, SLO/error budgets, cost/latency/tool/model/context metrics, business outcome linkage and backup/PITR/restore/replay/self-healing rehearsal.

tasks.title: W17-00 - Observability/Evidence Coordination & Telemetry Freeze
actions: 1. Inventory all runtime correlation/evidence surfaces W03-W16.
2. Freeze telemetry/evidence ownership, identifiers, cardinality constraints, retention/redaction and SLO dimensions.
3. Define reconstruction requirements for a task from intake to business outcome.
4. Define DP6 device telemetry requirements where applicable.
5. Create premortem for observability gaps, metric cardinality, evidence loss and DR false confidence.
tasks.forbidden: Do not make telemetry decide authority or adaptive promotion.

tasks.title: W17-A - OpenTelemetry & Correlation Completeness
actions: 1. Instrument gateway/context/router/planner/tools/policy/executor/provider/workflow/device paths with correlation/causation.
2. Define span/event naming and bounded attributes.
3. Propagate tenant-safe correlation without secrets.
4. Measure missing-correlation rate and async context propagation.
5. Add cross-service trace tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not store raw secrets/private CoT in spans.

tasks.title: W17-B - Durable Evidence Chain
actions: 1. Implement durable Evidence chain/index using canonical Evidence contracts.
2. Link receipts/readback/policy refs/outcomes and immutable provenance.
3. Detect missing/broken evidence links and tampering where architecture supports.
4. Support query/reconstruction by correlation.
5. Add partial-chain/integrity tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not create a parallel authority/audit decision model.

tasks.title: W17-C - StrategyExecutionRecord
actions: 1. Define StrategyExecutionRecord for task class, route, model/context/tools, budgets, confidence, policy/executor outcome and business result refs.
2. Exclude private chain-of-thought.
3. Version schema for W18 eval consumption.
4. Record fallback/escalation/degraded path.
5. Add schema/privacy tests.
tasks.forbidden: Telemetry record is observation, not permission or promotion.

tasks.title: W17-D - SLO & Error Budgets by Lane
actions: 1. Define measurable SLOs for Fast/Governed lanes and critical services.
2. Track availability/latency/error/uncertain/reconciliation/evidence completeness.
3. Define error budgets and alert/degraded-mode policies.
4. Calibrate thresholds from Aurora telemetry, not copied TOCA constants.
5. Add budget-burn simulations.
tasks.forbidden: Do not automatically relax safety to meet latency SLO.

tasks.title: W17-E - Cost, Latency, Tool, Model & Context Metrics
actions: 1. Measure p50/p95/p99 end-to-end and stage latency.
2. Track model/tool/retrieval/context fan-out, cache hit/miss, cost and coordination overhead.
3. Measure concurrency/queueing and bounded fan-out.
4. Provide dashboards/queries for W18 Economic Governor.
5. Add cardinality/cost controls.
tasks.forbidden: Do not optimize by omitting mandatory Policy/Authority/Evidence stages.

tasks.title: W17-F - Human Correction & Business Outcome Linkage
actions: 1. Link human correction/review and downstream business outcomes to StrategyExecutionRecord/evidence.
2. Preserve attribution uncertainty and provenance.
3. Define delayed-outcome update semantics.
4. Expose dataset-ready observations for W18 without direct learning promotion.
5. Add late/corrected outcome tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not treat correlation as causal proof or auto-promote strategy.

tasks.title: W17-G - Backup / PITR / Restore / Replay & Self-Healing Rehearsal
actions: 1. Define backup/PITR/restore scope for durable program data.
2. Run restore drills and verify consistency of outbox/inbox/evidence/read models.
3. Exercise replay/reconciliation/self-healing without duplicate side effects.
4. Measure RPO/RTO and document degraded/manual recovery.
5. Run four Risk Gates and publish W17 evidence sufficient for W18 and DP6 contribution.
tasks.forbidden: Do not claim recovery if side-effect state cannot be reconciled.
